name: Nano Banana
description: Google's latest image editing model in Gemini 2.5

examples.name: Cozy Coffee Shop
examples.description: Interior scene with warm lighting and a cat

input.prompt: A cozy coffee shop interior with warm lighting, plants hanging from the ceiling, and a cat sleeping on a velvet armchair by the window

code_snippets.label: cURL
code_snippets.code:
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/{ACCOUNT_ID}/ai/run/google/nano-banana \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {API_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
      "prompt": "A cozy coffee shop interior with warm lighting, plants hanging from the ceiling, and a cat sleeping on a velvet armchair by the window",
      "aspect_ratio": "16:9"
    }'
